data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'askēmos', meaning 'divine, godly, pious'. In early Christian texts, 'Askēmos' was used as a personal name for those who lived a pious and devout life. The name Aschim carries the meaning “Divine, Godly” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aschim usually hope their child will grow to embody divine, godly and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Aschim belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Divine, Godly.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aschim total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
